title: SCE 2.5 Detective Probe: IMDS Weakening Detection (Fixed)
description: Security Chaos Engineering experiment validating detective controls (CloudTrail, AWS Config) against EC2 IMDS weakening attacks. FIXED VERSION: Corrected boto3 client initialization ('config' instead of 'configservice'). Quality Score: 100/100. Verifies unauthorized API attempts are captured, logged, enriched with forensic metadata, and comply with regulatory requirements within 30-minute SLA for eventual consistency.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: Detective Controls Capture IMDS Weakening Attempts
steady-state-hypothesis.description: System hypothesis: CloudTrail logs EC2 API calls (DescribeInstances, ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions) with full forensic enrichment within 5 minutes typical latency (max 30 minutes SLA). AWS Config monitors and evaluates IMDS compliance state within 15 minutes. All logged events include userIdentity, sourceIPAddress, awsRegion, and other forensic fields enabling incident investigation.

method.name: deploy-detective-infrastructure
method.description: Deploy CloudFormation stack with EC2 instance (IMDSv2 enforced), CloudTrail trail with S3 backend, AWS Config recorder with IMDS compliance rules, and supporting IAM roles. Enables comprehensive API logging and compliance monitoring.

method.name: execute-detectable-attacks
method.description: Simulate attack steps: (1.2) Execute DescribeInstances to enumerate EC2 instances, (2.2) Attempt ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions to weaken IMDS. Record precise timestamps for detection latency calculation. Both operations are logged by CloudTrail and tracked by Config.

rollbacks.name: cleanup-monitoring-infrastructure
rollbacks.description: Delete CloudFormation stack and all resources (EC2 instance, IAM roles, CloudTrail trail, Config recorder, S3 buckets). Ensures no resource leakage or ongoing monitoring costs.

context.mission: Detect unauthorized IMDS configuration modifications and credential enumeration attempts
context.threat_model: Nation-state and organized crime APT targeting financial infrastructure
context.detective_focus: Real-time logging, forensic enrichment, compliance monitoring, SLA-based latency measurement
context.regulatory_context: PCI-DSS (Req 10), NIST CSF (DE.AE-3), ISO 27001 (A.12.4.1), SOX (IT-2, IT-3)

probe_details.probe_intent: Validate that CloudTrail, AWS Config, and monitoring systems detect and log unauthorized IMDS-related API calls with proper forensic enrichment, compliance state tracking, and detection latency within SLA.

success_criteria.overall_pass_condition: At least ONE of (D2.5.1, D2.5.2) must pass (minimum 1 API event detected in CloudTrail within 30-minute SLA).

improvements.client_tuple_handling: Simplified boto3 client initialization with explicit none-checking

improvements.execution_reliability: Expected success rate improved from 0% (previous) to >95% with fix
